Fall Guys
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️☆ (Recommended)

Fall Guys bursts onto the scene with its colorful chaos and addictive gameplay. This battle royale party game delivers a hilarious and frantic experience as players navigate through whimsical obstacle courses and compete in mini-games. Its simple controls and charming aesthetics make it accessible to players of all skill levels, while the unpredictable nature of each round keeps the excitement level high. However, occasional server issues and the lack of variety in game modes may dampen long-term enthusiasm. Nevertheless, Fall Guys is a delightful multiplayer romp that is sure to bring laughter and enjoyment to gatherings of friends and family alike.

Fall Guys is a delightful multiplayer experience that combines charming visuals, addictive gameplay, and hilarious chaos. With its vibrant and whimsical world, it's easy to get lost in the fun-filled races and challenges. Whether you're playing with friends or jumping into online matches, Fall Guys is guaranteed to bring a smile to your face and keep you coming back for more.

Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout is one of the most enjoyable online gaming experiences. With simple controls, heaps of fun, replayable mini-games and customizations (paid or won) that do not alter the gameplay, and a catchy background tune, Fall Guys has everything that causes addictive play. Indeed, even when you are eliminated, there is the immediate urge to hop back in and try your luck again. The only thing that lets Fall Guys down is the inability to play local matches against friends on your couch. The vibrant levels, with their inflatable-like obstacles and moving platforms wouldn’t be out of place on a TV game show. Indeed, I’m now looking forward to the Fall Guys: Ultimate Knockout TV adaption, where players must don Fall Guy suits and compete in a similar series of wacky and enjoyable events. Until then, Fall Guys will be my multiplayer game of choice.

Great game for some occasional brainless fun.
I am not that into the battle royal aspect of it but I enjoyed playing the game nonetheless.

The game's colorful and whimsical design is an instant mood-lifter, and the wacky obstacles and challenges provide endless entertainment. Whether you're dodging giant fruit or trying to navigate a chaotic obstacle course, Fall Guys keeps you on your toes and keeps the laughs coming.

Of course, the game's physics can be a bit wonky at times - I'm pretty sure my bean-shaped character has defied the laws of gravity on more than one occasion. But honestly, that's part of the fun. It's like the game is in on the joke, and we're all just along for the ride.

One downside is that the matchmaking can be a bit hit-or-miss at times, with occasional long wait times or connection issues. But honestly, I'm willing to overlook that for the pure joy that Fall Guys brings.

Overall, I'd give Fall Guys a funny and fun 5 out of 5 - it's the perfect game to play with friends or to unwind after a long day. Just be prepared to lose a few brain cells from all the laughter.

reason.text: Negative reviews from this period focus on a new requirement to create and link an Epic Games account to play on Steam.
Reviews also say the game installs Epic software, with one calling it "Epic Games Tools" installed without permission.
